traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are implemented and backed by code, tests, and documentation: - Core Functionality & REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS: The plugin exposes recommended and strict presets via configs.recommended and configs.strict in src/index.ts, with severities defined in TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES. Tests in tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts assert the rule set contents and that strict mirrors recommended. - Quality Standards & REQ-FLAT-CONFIG: The project uses ESLint v9 flat config (eslint.config.js) combining @eslint/js recommended config with plugin integration and file-type-specific overrides. The setup aligns with ESLint 9 flat-config best practices and is fully documented in user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md. - Integration & REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION: Integration with existing ESLint setups is validated by the CLI integration test (tests/integration/cli-integration.test.ts) which runs ESLint CLI with this flat config and plugin rules, and by multiple documentation examples showing how to append traceability.configs.recommended/strict to standard @eslint/js configurations for JS, TS, mixed, and monorepo projects. - Customizable paths & rule options (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS, REQ-RULE-OPTIONS): The valid-story-reference rule defines configurable options (storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension) with a strict JSON schema, and these options are documented and tested. Additional per-rule options are documented for other rules in user-docs/api-reference.md and individual docs/rules/*.md files. - Error Handling & REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION: Configuration validation is implemented via the JSON schema on valid-story-reference with additionalProperties: false, and explicitly tested in tests/config/eslint-config-validation.test.ts, which is annotated with this story. Plugin loading in eslint.config.js includes CI-aware error handling to fail fast in CI and degrade gracefully in local development. - User Experience & Documentation: README.md, user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md, user-docs/examples.md, user-docs/api-reference.md, and docs/config-presets.md collectively provide clear setup instructions, configuration examples across common project types (JS, TS, mixed, monorepo, tests), and a detailed troubleshooting section for ESLint flat config. These materials satisfy the documentation-related acceptance criteria.
Given the presence of targeted tests tied to this story, the flat-config implementation, configurable rule options with validation, and extensive documentation and examples, this story is fully implemented and verified.
